description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for followers in a social media-like application. It includes a command class, a validator, and a handler that processes the removal of a follower relationship between users.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: A request message representing the command to unfollow a user, identified by username.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Username in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the process of removing a follower relationship and returning the profile of the user.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the process of verifying user existence, removing the follow relationship, and returning the profile information.
